children.name: Subtitle
children.text: Screen-space Canvas / mouse events / JSON + C# runtime

children.name: Multiline
children.text:
Explicit line breaks
Tinted text + alpha

children.name: TextNote
children.text: Rect size does not wrap or clip text.

children.name: ImageKeys
children.text: Buttons inherit texture, UV and image layout.

children.name: LayoutNote
children.text: Click rotated button / mirrored image: see log.

children.name: TreeStatus
children.text: C# creates a container, image and text.

children.name: OrderKeys
children.text: O: move overlay Canvas above / below

children.name: EventLog
children.text: Move onto a target to see events.

children.name: EventHint
children.text:
Down + release outside: Up only.
Hold + D / lose focus: Cancel.

children.name: PauseInfo
children.text:
Pause stops script Update.
UI callbacks remain active.
Resume with the modal button.

children.name: LifetimeNote
children.text:
Prefab: click to dismiss or wait 3s.
Runtime card: click to delete its subtree.

children.name: Footer
children.text: Click the controls. Drag off the event probe to release without a Click; D toggles its Interactable state.

children.name: Contracts
children.text: Resize: anchored layout | R: UI scale | O: overlay order | M: pause menu | Esc: exit (while running)

children.name: Exit
children.text: Clipping, automatic text wrapping, keyboard focus and world-space Canvas are not implemented.
